review_scope: Independent static worker/controller/protocol/audit review; pure nine Python evidence controls, six Node bounded queue controls, worker syntax, AST parsing. No native Harness, SQLite, model, scientific suite, network or provider execution. Root must separately freeze and run at most one suite.
resolved_findings: Exhaustion retains exact native lastResult including overload key; regression tests cover deadline and attempt ceiling native-shaped results.

Audit rejects false final results, invalid overload prefixes, missing pending provenance, altered native task inputs, wrong authority versions, mismatched durable request fingerprints, and recovered finish identities/checkpoints.
All 14 controls must carry distinct per-Session admitted task identities; terminal/effect/recovery counts are derived from records.
limitations: Two independent Harness/Session SQLite instances, trusted-host custom tasks and local transactional effects only.
Finite 10ms scheduled arrivals retain actual lateness; native async admission can block. Retry age is checked before admission starts, not its completion.
Single-owner volatile bounded pending queue drains before crashes; history, finished and effect logs grow.
One fixed-order refusal/retry pair; timing-dependent unequal accepted cohorts; descriptive costs, no causal benefit or full-Agent/model/production claim.
